topic: Leigh Hochberg & BrainGate2 96-Channel Motor Cortex Array, Five-Year Chronic Survival & Cathy Hutchinson's Thought-Controlled Robotic Arm Coffee Sip (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Cathy Hutchinson using her five-year-old motor cortex sensor to steer a silver five-fingered robotic arm across a tabletop, grasp an insulated coffee bottle, and sip independently after fifteen years of paralysis.
